question: Can one or two frequently used fast V3 edges improve C1 multi-cluster latency over the validated sparse gate without losing its GPU-work advantage?
edge_selection_evidence: Only C1_multi V3 development seed121/122 route_counts were used. Among edges omitted by the old sparse gate, 19->16 appeared in 53/192 routed prompts and 17->19 in 42/192; both are legal 1.16-1.175 GB/s links. The next omitted fast edge appeared in 21/192. Old formal seed0/1/2 outcomes were not used to choose these edges.
control: old sparse gate, paired by seed, trace, layout, simulator and runtime
selection: A candidate enters new-seed long-window confirmation only if all five screening constraints pass. Among passers select lowest mean common-completed P95 TPOT; do not change this screen after seeing the development results.
scope: Exploratory method development. Unseen 1800-second seeds are required before any performance claim.
